summary_md: **Serhii Shyman ([@5haman](https://x.com/5haman/status/2116741652987400200))** notes *Spec2Game* by Cai et al. ([arXiv 2610.04253](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.04253v1)) found LLM-generated Pygame projects that run can still miss specified rules and win conditions, while cautioning the study used no runtime feedback so it doesn't bound iterative agents.

referenced_urls.title: Spec2Game: Can LLMs Generate Complete Playable Games from Detailed Specifications?

relevance: Spec fidelity in agentic game generation.
